objective: Run the final structural screen for the four-anchor outer FFN at 1/32768 gain, retaining a direct branch cap of 0.5 and stopping the branch on failure.

authorization_basis.prior_outcome: All carrier, state-control, exact-zero, finiteness, and global 2.0 bounds passed, but the direct outer-versus-attention-only effect was 1.125 to 1.656 against the 0.5 cap.
authorization_basis.architectural_response: Reduce only the four-anchor outer gain by 4x from 1/8192 to 1/32768.

architecture.direct_ablation: addressed_moe_outer_ffn versus addressed_moe_controller with identical state, carrier, gain, and MoE parameters
architecture.zero_recurrent_identity: Zero recurrence is exactly projected-only; inactive layers are exact no-ops.

execution.distribution: one locked source/donor pair per rank; no optimization

stopping_rule.pass: Authorize one separately locked causal training run with 390 trainable tensors and the remaining open endpoint.
stopping_rule.failure: Stop the outer-FFN branch and keep the held-out endpoint closed.
stopping_rule.always: Do not open publisher validation/test, Hard32, the unused strength holdout, or native generation.
